original_text: Preserve the source 7 columns on X and 6 rows on Y, the yellow/red turn order and gravity toward Y=0. Add a Z depth axis of extent 4. A piece is placed by selecting a cell and must land on the lowest empty Y of its (X,Z) column. Connecting 4 pieces along any of the 13 straight 3D directions wins; a full board is a draw.
changes: Add Z depth axis of extent 4
Piece drops to lowest empty Y in selected (X,Z) column
Win condition: 4 connected pieces along any of the 13 straight 3D directions
constraints: Board grid dimensions: X=7, Y=6, Z=4
Gravity acts along Y axis toward Y=0
